Message.Name: Enter Order Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event. The format is as follows:

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: As described above in Data Types. You can put any information you like. Token must be day-unique for each OUCH account.

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: Buy/Sell Indicator

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Total number of shares. Must be greater than zero and less than 1,000,000

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock Symbol

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price of the order. Please refer to the section in Data Types for more clarification.

Field.Name: Time in Force
Field.Description: The number of seconds that this order should live before being automatically canceled. Special values for Time in Force are listed in Data Types above.

Field.Name: Firm
Field.Description: This field should contain all caps. Firm Identifier for the order entry firm. One logical OUCH Account can potentially enter orders for multiple firms in a Service Bureau configuration. If this field is blank-filled, the default firm for the OUCH Account will be used.

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: Display

Field.Name: Capacity
Field.Description: Values other than “A”, “P”, or “R” will be converted to “O” = Other

Field.Name: Intermarket Sweep Eligibility
Field.Description: Intermarket Sweep Eligibility

Field.Name: Minimum Quantity
Field.Description: Specifies the minimum acceptable quantity to execute

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: Cross Type

Field.Name: Customer Type
Field.Description: Indicates if the order is a retail designated order (optional field)

Message.Name: Replace Order Message
Message.Description: The Replace Order Message allows you to alter most of the attributes of an order in a single message. This is more efficient than canceling an existing order and immediately succeeding it with a new order. Replacing an order always gives it a new timestamp for its time priority on the book. If you wish you simply partially cancel an order and retain its time priority, send a Cancel Order Message instead.

Field.Name: Existing Order Token
Field.Description: This must be filled out with the exact Order Token sent on the Enter Order Message or last Replace Order Message.

Field.Name: Replacement Order Token
Field.Description: As described above in Data Types. You can put any information you like. Token must be day-unique for each OUCH account.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Total number of shares liable, inclusive of previous executions and Self Match Prevention decremented shares on this order chain. Must be greater than zero and less than 1,000,000

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price of the replacement order. Please refer to the section in Data Types for more clarification.

Field.Name: Time in Force
Field.Description: The number of seconds that this replacement should live before being automatically canceled. Special values for Time in Force are listed in Data Types above.

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: Display

Field.Name: Intermarket Sweep Eligibility
Field.Description: Intermarket Sweep Eligibility

Field.Name: Minimum Quantity
Field.Description: Specifies the minimum acceptable quantity to execute

Message.Name: Cancel Order Message
Message.Description: The Cancel Order Message is used to request that an order be canceled or reduced. In the Cancel Order Message, you must specify the new "intended order size" for the order. The "intended order size" is the maximum number of shares that can be executed in total after the cancel is applied.

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: The Order Token as was originally transmitted in an Enter Order Message

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: This is the new intended order size. This limits the maximum number of shares that can potentially be executed in total after the cancel is applied. Entering a zero here will cancel any remaining open shares on this order.

Message.Name: Modify Order Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order Message is used to request modifications that will not affect order priority on the book unless the share amount is increased. Since priority of the order does not change (exception noted), allowed modifications are restricted to only the ones specified in the message details below.

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: The Order Token as was originally transmitted in an Enter Order Message

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: Only following transitions allowed: S->T, S->E, E->T, E->S, T->E, T->S

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Total number of shares liable, inclusive of previous executions and Self Match Prevention decremented shares on this order chain. Must be greater than zero and less than 1,000,000

Message.Name: Trade Now Message
Message.Description: The Trade Now Message is used to request that an order remove against any available shares of locking contra-side orders. Usage of the Trade Now Message will not affect order priority on the book

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: The Order Token as was originally transmitted in an Enter Order Message

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: System Event Messages signal events that affect the entire NASDAQ system:

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp – reflected as the number of nanoseconds past midnight.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: See Event Codes below.

Message.Name: Accepted Message
Message.Description: Functionality that is not available will be greyed out in the specifications. Any changes will be conveyed via the NASDAQ Head Trader Alerts or Technical Updates.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp – reflected as the number of nanoseconds past midnight.

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: The Order Token field as entered

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: Buy/Sell Indicator as entered

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Total number of shares accepted

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol as entered

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The accepted price of the order. Please note that the accepted price could potentially be different than the entered price if the orderwas re-priced by NASDAQ on entry. The accepted price will always be better than or equal to the entered price.

Field.Name: Time in Force
Field.Description: The accepted Time in Force of the order. Please note that the accepted Time in Force may potentially be different than the entered Time in Force. The accepted Time in Force will always b equal to or shorter in scope than the entered Time in Force.

Field.Name: Firm
Field.Description: The accepted firm for the order. Please note that if the firm was left blank on entry, the default firm for the OUCH account will appear here.

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: The accepted display type ofor the order.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The day-unique Order Reference Number assigned by NASDAQ to this order

Field.Name: Capacity
Field.Description: The capacity specified on the order

Field.Name: Intermarket Sweep Eligibility
Field.Description: Intermarket Sweep Eligibility

Field.Name: Minimum Quantity
Field.Description: Minimum number of shares to execute on the replacement.

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: The Cross Type as entered

Field.Name: Order State
Field.Description: Order State

Field.Name: BBO Weight indicator
Field.Description: BBO Weight indicator

Message.Name: Replaced Message
Message.Description: This message acknowledges the receipt and acceptance of a valid Replace Order Message. The data fields from the Replace Order Message are echoed back in this message. Note that the accepted values may differ from the entered values for some fields. You will receive one and only one of these two for each replacement.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp – reflected as the number of nanoseconds past midnight.

Field.Name: Replacement Order Token
Field.Description: The Replacement Order Token field as entered

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: Buy/sell indicator as entered on the original order in the chain

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Total number of shares outstanding

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol as entered on the original

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The accepted price of the replacement. Please note that the accepted price could potentially be different than the entered price if the order was re-priced by NASDAQ on entry. The accepted price will always be better than or equal to the entered.

Field.Name: Time in Force
Field.Description: The accepted Time in Force of the replacement. Please note that the accepted Time in Force may potentially be different than the entered Time in Force. The accepted Time in Force will always be equal to or shorter in scope than the entered Time in Force.

Field.Name: Firm
Field.Description: The accepted firm for the original order.

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: The accepted display type for the order.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The day-unique Order Reference Number assigned by NASDAQ to this order

Field.Name: Capacity
Field.Description: The Capacity of original order.

Field.Name: Intermarket Sweep Eligibility
Field.Description: Intermarket Sweep Eligibility

Field.Name: Minimum Quantity
Field.Description: Minimum number of shares to execute on the replacement.

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: The Cross Type of the replacement

Field.Name: Order State
Field.Description: Order State

Field.Name: Previous Order Token
Field.Description: The Order Token of the order that was replaced

Field.Name: BBO Weight indicator
Field.Description: BBO Weight indicator

Message.Name: Canceled Message
Message.Description: A Canceled Message informs you that an order has been reduced or canceled. This could be acknowledging a Cancel Order Message, or it could be the result of the order timing out or being canceled automatically.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp – reflected as the number of nanoseconds past midnight.

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: The Order Token of the order being reduced

Field.Name: Decrement Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares just decremented from the order. This number is incremental, not cumulative.

Field.Name: Cancel Order Reason
Field.Description: Reason the order was reduced or canceled

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp – reflected as the number of nanoseconds past midnight.

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: The Order Token of the order being reduced

Field.Name: Decrement Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares just decremented from the order. This number is incremental, not cumulative.

Field.Name: Cancel Order Reason
Field.Description: Reason the order was reduced or canceled. For AIQ Cancel message, this value will be “Q”.

Field.Name: Quantity Prevented from Trading
Field.Description: Shares that would have executed if the trade would have occurred. Depending on AIQ type and the sizes of orders in question the value for this field could either be the same or different than the Decrement Shares field. For “Decrement both” they are always the same. For “Cancel oldest” they will be different if the incoming order is smaller than the resting order.

Field.Name: Execution price
Field.Description: Price at which the trade would have occurred

Field.Name: Liquidity flag
Field.Description: Liquidity flag the order would have received

Message.Name: Executed Message
Message.Description: An Executed Order Message informs you that all or part of an order has been executed

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp – reflected as the number of nanoseconds past midnight

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: The Order Token of the executing order

Field.Name: Executed Shares
Field.Description: Incremental number of shares executed

Field.Name: Execution Price
Field.Description: The price at which these shares were executed

Field.Name: Liquidity Flag
Field.Description: See Liquidity Flag Values table below.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Assigned by NASDAQ to each match executed. Each match consists of one buy and one sell. The matching buy and sell executions share the same match number.

Message.Name: Broken Trade Message
Message.Description: A Broken Trade Message informs you that an execution has been broken. The trade is no longer good and will not clear. The reason for the break is given.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp – reflected as the number of nanoseconds past midnight.

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: The Order Token of the order for which the given Match Number is being broken.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Match Number as transmitted in the Executed Order Message being broken.

Field.Name: Broken Trade Reason
Field.Description: The reason the trade was broken. See currently supported Broken Trade Reasons table below. Clients should anticipate additions to this list and thus support all capital letters of the English alphabet.

Message.Name: Executed with Reference Price Message
Message.Description: An Executed Order Message informs you that all or part of an order has been executed.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp – reflected as the number of nanoseconds past midnight

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: The Order Token of the executing order

Field.Name: Executed Shares
Field.Description: Incremental number of shares executed

Field.Name: Execution Price
Field.Description: The price at which these shares were executed

Field.Name: Liquidity Flag
Field.Description: See Liquidity Flag Values table below.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Assigned by NASDAQ to each match executed. Each match consists of one buy and one sell. The matching buy and sell executions share the same match number.

Field.Name: Reference Price
Field.Description: The reference price associated with the execution

Field.Name: Reference Price Type
Field.Description: Only value currently supported is: I = Intraday Indicative Value

Message.Name: Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: An Executed Restatement Message informs you that there has been a change to an execution.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp – reflected as the number of nanoseconds past midnight

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: The Order Token of the executing order

Field.Name: Executed Shares
Field.Description: Incremental number of shares executed

Field.Name: Execution Price
Field.Description: The price at which these shares were executed

Field.Name: Liquidity Flag
Field.Description: See Liquidity Flag Values table below.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Assigned by NASDAQ to each match executed. Each match consists of one buy and one sell. The matching buy and sell executions share the same match number.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Only value currently allowed is: N = Adjusted to NAV

Message.Name: Rejected Order Message
Message.Description: A Rejected Message may be sent in response to an Enter Order Message or Replace Order Message if the order or replace cannot be accepted at this time. The reason for the rejection is given.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp – reflected as the number of nanoseconds past midnight

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: Order Token field as was entered.

Field.Name: Rejected Order Reason
Field.Description: The reason the order was rejected. See currently supported Rejected Order Reasons below. Clients should anticipate additions to this list and thus support all capital letters of the English alphabet.

Message.Name: Cancel Pending Message
Message.Description: This message will only be sent once for a given token. Duplicate cancel requests for the same token will be ignored by OUCH.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp – reflected as the number of nanoseconds past midnight

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: Order Token for the order that has its cancel pended

Message.Name: Cancel Reject Message
Message.Description: This message will only be sent once for a given token. Duplicate cancel requests for the same token will be ignored by OUCH.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp – reflected as the number of nanoseconds past midnight.

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: Order Token for the order that was cancel-rejected

Message.Name: Order Priority Update Message
Message.Description: A Priority Update Message is sent whenever priority of the order has been changed by the system.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp – reflected as the number of nanoseconds past midnight.

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: This is the order Token of the order whose priority has been updated

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit price of the order.

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: The display type for the order. “Y” = Anonymous -Price to Comply

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The day-unique Order Reference Number assigned by NASDAQ to this order. As a result of the updated priority, a new order reference number will be assigned.

Message.Name: Order Modified Message
Message.Description: An Order Modified Message is sent in response to an order modify request.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp – reflected as the number of nanoseconds past midnight.

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: This is the order Token of the order that was modified

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: Buy/sell indicator as entered.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Total number of shares outstanding

Message.Name: Sequenced Trade Now Message
Message.Description: The Trade Now Message is used to request that an order remove against any available shares of locking contra-side orders. Usage of the Trade Now Message will not affect order priority on the book

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp – reflected as the number of nanoseconds past midnight.

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: This is the order Token of the order that was modified

Value.Name: sell short
Value.Description: sell short, client affirms ability to borrow securities in good deliverable form for delivery within three business days

Value.Name: sell short exempt
Value.Description: sell short exempt, client affirms ability to borrow securities in good deliverable form for delivery within three business days

Value.Name: Imbalance-Only
Value.Description: Imbalance-Only (for opening and closing cross only)

Value.Name: Post-Only and Attributable
Value.Description: Post-Only and Attributable – Price to Display

Value.Name: Mid-Point
Value.Description: Mid-Point Peg and Mid-Point Trade Now

Value.Name: Halt/IPO cross
Value.Description: Halt/IPO cross (Must be market price, refer to Prices in Data Types)

Value.Name: Start of Day — This is always the first message each day.
Value.Description: Start of Day — This is always the first message each day. It indicates that NASDAQ is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: End of Day — This indicates that NASDAQ is now closed and will not accept any new orders or replaces in this session.
Value.Description: End of Day — This indicates that NASDAQ is now closed and will not accept any new orders or replaces in this session. There will be no further executions during this session; however, it is still possible to receive Broken Trade Messages and Canceled Order Messages

Value.Name: Sets the QBBO
Value.Description: Sets the QBBO while joining the NBBO

Value.Name: User requested cancel.
Value.Description: User requested cancel. Sent in response to a Cancel Order Message or a Replace Order Message

Value.Name: Immediate or Cancel order.
Value.Description: Immediate or Cancel order. This order was originally sent with a timeout of zero and no further matches were available on the book so the remaining unexecuted shares were immediately canceled

Value.Name: Timeout.
Value.Description: Timeout. The Time In Force for this order has expired

Value.Name: Supervisory.
Value.Description: Supervisory. This order was manually canceled or reduced by a NASDAQ supervisory terminal. This is usually in response to a participant request via telephone.

Value.Name: This order cannot be executed because of a regulatory restriction.
Value.Description: This order cannot be executed because of a regulatory restriction (e.g.: trade through restrictions).

Value.Name: Self Match Prevention.
Value.Description: Self Match Prevention. The order was cancelled because it would have executed with an existing order entered by the same MPID.

Value.Name: System cancel.
Value.Description: System cancel. This order was cancelled by the system.

Value.Name: Cross canceled.
Value.Description: Cross canceled. Non-bookable cross orders that did not execute in the cross.

Value.Name: This order cannot be executed
Value.Description: This order cannot be executed because of Market Collars

Value.Name: Halted.
Value.Description: Halted. The on-open order was canceled because the symbol remained halted after the opening cross completed.

Value.Name: Open Protection.
Value.Description: Open Protection. Orders that are cancelled as a result of the Opening Price Protection Threshold.

Value.Name: Closed
Value.Description: Closed. Any DAY order that was received after the closing cross is complete in a given symbol will receive this cancel reason.

Value.Name: Post Only Cancel.
Value.Description: Post Only Cancel. This Post Only order was cancelled because it would have been price slid for NMS.

Value.Name: Post Only Cancel.
Value.Description: Post Only Cancel. This Post Only order was cancelled because it would have been price slid due to a contra side displayed order on the book.

Value.Name: Added
Value.Description: Added liquidity via a midpoint order

Value.Name: Displayed

Value.Name: Displayed
Value.Description: Displayed, liquidity-adding order sets the QBBO while joining the NBBO

Value.Name: Retail designated

Value.Name: Retail designated

Value.Name: Retail designated

Value.Name: RPI (Retail Price Improving)
Value.Description: RPI (Retail Price Improving) order provides liquidity

Value.Name: Retail Order
Value.Description: Retail Order removes price improving non-displayed liquidity other than RPI liquidity

Value.Name: Added
Value.Description: Added displayed liquidity in a Group A symbol

Value.Name: Added
Value.Description: Added non-displayed liquidity in a Group A symbol

Value.Name: Removed
Value.Description: Removed liquidity in a Group A symbol

Value.Name: Added
Value.Description: Added non-displayed mid-point liquidity in a Group A symbol

Value.Name: Erroneous
Value.Description: Erroneous — The trade was deemed clearly erroneous.

Value.Name: Consent
Value.Description: Consent — The two parties mutually agreed to break the trade.

Value.Name: Supervisory
Value.Description: Supervisory — The trade was manually broken by a NASDAQ supervisory terminal.

Value.Name: External
Value.Description: External — The trade was broken by an externalthird party.

Value.Name: Test Mode
Value.Description: Test Mode — This OUCH Account is configured for test mode and is not able to accept orders in non-TEST securities.

Value.Name: Halted
Value.Description: Halted — There is currently a trading halt so no orders can be accepted in this stock at this time.

Value.Name: Shares exceeds configured safety threshold
Value.Description: Shares exceeds configured safety threshold — The number of shares entered must be less than the safety threshold configured for this Account. The safety threshold can be added/updated through NASDAQ Subscriber Services.

Value.Name: Invalid stock
Value.Description: Invalid stock — The stock field must be a valid issue, tradable on NASDAQ.

Value.Name: Invalid Display Type.
Value.Description: Invalid Display Type — Sent when Display Type Entered cannot be accepted in current circumstances and can’t be simply converted to a valid Display Type.

Value.Name: Requested firm not authorized for requested clearing type on this account
Value.Description: Requested firm not authorized for requested clearing type on this account — To authorize additional firms, use the NASDAQ Service Bureau Agreement.

Value.Name: Outside of permitted times
Value.Description: Outside of permitted times for requested clearing type

Value.Name: This order is not allowed in this type of cross
Value.Description: This order is not allowed in this type of cross (stock or time restrictions).

Value.Name: There is no reference price
Value.Description: There is no reference price in the first NOII dissemination and so no LOC orders can be accepted in this stock at this time

Value.Name: Midpoint Peg orders are not accepted
Value.Description: Midpoint Peg orders are not accepted in a crossed market

Value.Name: LOC Order priced more aggressively
Value.Description: LOC Order priced more aggressively than the first NOII reference price
